baseline.current_version_or_revision: OLEANDER Current Architecture v2.1 / Master Runtime v1.0

trigger_evidence: User requested OLEANDER orchestration across ERP + PLM + MES + BPM + QMS + MBSE + Knowledge Graph + Agent Runtime.

Current OLEANDER already exposes Project Axis, Knowledge Plane, Job State, capability routing, execution DAG, native artifact, readback/review, persistence, drift/recovery and controlled evolution primitives.

ISA-95-style enterprise/operations separation, BPMN-style process semantics, SysML-v2-style requirements/interfaces/V&V and PROV-style lineage are useful reference patterns only and do not replace OLEANDER authority.
Current resilience contract forbids a persistent transaction ledger/distributed transaction manager; partial side effects therefore require explicit reconciliation under existing owners.
Case Axis identity remains independent from Project Axis identity; a Case ID may not synthesize or prove a P2 Project ID.
hypothesis: A single federated, non-authoritative enterprise projection envelope with ERP, PLM, MES, BPM, QMS, MBSE, Knowledge Graph and Agent Runtime modules can improve planning, configuration, execution, quality, systems traceability, provenance and agent observability without creating another architecture, system of record, state machine or authority path.

semantic_repairs: projection freshness is separated from enterprise readiness
CURRENT_PROJECTION / STALE_PROJECTION labels are retired from the active schema
module_source_coverage is retired from the active schema
enterprise readiness is recomputed from module scope, blocking links, design review state and uncertain side effects

comparison.baseline_result: Current OLEANDER exposes the required primitives but no unified ERP-style read/projection model.
comparison.quality_delta: POSITIVE_CANDIDATE_SIGNAL: v0.3.1 separates source/projection freshness from enterprise readiness and separates source binding from triggered module coverage.
comparison.reliability_delta: IMPROVED_FAIL_CLOSED_SEMANTICS: dashboards and downstream readers cannot legally infer enterprise completeness from source binding or infer Current/readiness from projection freshness.
comparison.cost_latency_delta: PENDING_REAL_CASE_EVAL; no claim that federation reduces execution cost or latency yet.
comparison.decision_basis: v0.3.1 successor preserves v0.3 provenance while retiring ambiguous CURRENT_PROJECTION and module_source_coverage semantics. Real C01/C04/Fallingwater projections and independent review remain pending.

migration.affected_scope: Future only after eval + independent review + human promotion.
migration_steps: Validate the eight-module candidate schema, support mappings and negative invariants.
Run read-only projections against representative C01/C04/Fallingwater cases.
Measure duplicate authority, state collapse, untraceable links, stale-source and partial-side-effect failures.
Run independent strict architecture + domain review.
If accepted, prepare append-only Current integration bindings; do not create R-L.
Run full OLEANDER regression and cross-platform readback before human promotion.

rollback.rollback_action: Delete or ignore the candidate projection package; no Current pointer changes are required at Stage 1.
rollback.rollback_test: All existing Current validators must produce the same result with candidate directory absent.
rollback.provenance_ref: Git diff plus baseline SHA set recorded in this candidate.

monitoring.monitor_window_or_condition: During candidate evaluation and representative read-only projections.
regression_signals: any module status substitutes for an existing OLEANDER state family
projection object or Knowledge Graph edge gains authority
PLM release/MES complete/BPM complete/QMS pass/MBSE verify/Agent success upgrades Design or Promotion
distributed transaction manager or persistent event ledger appears
uncertain side effect advances without reconciliation
projection writes to Current during candidate evaluation
monitoring.reopen_rule: Any regression signal reopens EV1 and blocks promotion.
